decisions.reason: A same-message MODIFY already captures the explicit splash target and optional splash-guard policy; the stronger texture target requires no additional change.
A same-message MODIFY already captures the cleaning and removability clause, while the stronger texture target does not change quick bowl swapping.
The stronger frothy-texture target does not necessarily change the already selected 2.5-quart bowl capacity or bowl form.
The existing same-message MODIFY already captures the motor and whisk evaluation criteria associated with achieving the stronger frothy texture.
The client asks for input on alternative whisk materials and styles but does not select a replacement configuration; propagation would require a later client decision.
The source does not change spout geometry, orientation, construction, or appearance, and the existing beverage-quality constraint remains valid.
The existing same-message MODIFY already captures the solenoid mechanism, operation sequence, and controlled non-sputtering flow; no additional consequence follows from the texture target.
The source reiterates that spout components should be easy to clean or removable, which is already represented by the current cleaning requirement and method.
The matcha texture change has no effect on the machine name, retained wording, or placard placement.
The source reiterates sealing against leaks into the base, which is already represented, and the stronger texture target adds no plumbing-state change.
The target texture has no effect on the established beige and green color scheme.
The stronger frothy-texture target does not change the DJ-turntable-inspired visual identity.
